about.description:
EVAC is the Kazakhstan national system of emergency calls in case of accidents and disasters. 
The system operates using signals and data from GPS and GLONASS satellite navigation systems. 
In case of an emergency (fire, sudden attack of illness, attack), the driver or passenger has the opportunity to call emergency services using the panic button. 
The system will ensure maximum response speed for emergency services.

features.auto_call_desc: The system itself calls rescuers in case of a serious accident, even if the driver is unconscious.
features.channel_112_desc: The signal goes directly to the dispatcher
features.coords_desc: The built-in GPS/GLONASS chip instantly transmits the exact location of the vehicle to service 112.
features.monitoring_desc: 24/7 call reception throughout the Republic of Kazakhstan

uveos_info.subtitle: Installation procedure for UVEOS on used cars
uveos_info.text1: On January 1, 2015, the standards for equipping vehicles with emergency call devices came into force in accordance with the Technical Regulations of the Customs Union “On the safety of wheeled vehicles” TR CU 018/2011.
uveos_info.text2: Since 2016, passenger cars weighing more than 2.5 tons, buses, trucks and special vehicles for transporting dangerous goods have been required to be equipped with UVEOS.
uveos_info.text3:
In accordance with the regulations TR CU 018/2011, from January 1, 2017, the installation of UVEOS on manufactured vehicles of categories M and N is carried out by manufacturers. 
This applies to both cars produced in Kazakhstan and those imported from abroad.
uveos_info.text4:
Vehicles imported into Kazakhstan and undergoing initial state registration are required to be equipped with UVEOS. 
Registration without the established UVEOS is not carried out.
uveos_info.title: Norms and procedures for equipping vehicles with an emergency call system

items[0].answer:
For subscribers of the ERA-GLONASS emergency call system, there are 3 categories of vehicles with an installed identification card:

1) Vehicles registered in the Russian Federation and temporarily located on the territory of the Republic of Kazakhstan;

2) Vehicles produced before January 1, 2019;

3) Vehicles manufactured after January 1, 2019.

For the first category of cars, the connection occurs automatically. 
No additional data required. 
We will automatically request everything you need from the ERA-GLONASS operator.

For the second category of cars, the connection also occurs automatically. 
To work, we need to obtain the VIN code and ICCID, make, model, color and year of manufacture of U(S)VEOS for each car sold. 
For the third category of cars, connection is carried out only after paying a one-time payment (25,840 tenge, including 12% VAT).

If the VIN code and ICCID, make, model, color and year of manufacture of the U(S)VEOS are not specified for the second and third categories of vehicles, the operation of the U(S)VEOS will not be possible.
items[0].question: How do ERA-GLONASS emergency call systems work on cars in Kazakhstan after the EVAC system has been put into commercial operation since 01/01/2019?

items[1].answer:
Registration of cars with an installed ERA-GLONASS identification card, issued before January 1, 2019, in the EVAC system database is free of charge. 
This means that all cars manufactured before 01/01/2019 will be registered in the EVAC system database free of charge, regardless of when they were sold. 
All cars manufactured after January 1, 2019 are registered at the approved tariffs of the EVAC system operator.
items[1].question: Is the EVAC SIM profile different from the Russian ERA-GLONASS profile?

items[2].answer: To purchase SIM profiles, it is necessary to conclude a tripartite agreement between the EVAC system operator, the SIM card manufacturer and the device manufacturer.
items[2].question: What happens to vehicles equipped with a previously released emergency call device/system?

items[3].answer:
All vehicles equipped with a module with an ERA-GLONASS SIM card and registered in the EVAC system will operate in Kazakhstan, and the EVAC system will function on these vehicles. 
To connect vehicles to the EVAC system, automakers or official dealers provide the EVAC operator with information in the form of an Excel file indicating the vehicle VIN code and the ICCID code U(C)VEOS installed on the vehicle, as well as the make, model, color and year of manufacture of the vehicle.
items[3].question: What mechanism is provided for a painless transition from ERA-GLONASS conditions to the EVAC system for vehicles equipped with U(S)VEOS and passed confirmation of compliance?

items[4].answer:
Ensuring compliance with the requirements of paragraph 6 of Article 33 of the Law of the Republic of Kazakhstan “On Road Traffic”. 
U(C)VEOS installed on vehicles must have a certificate of compliance with TR CU 018 “On the safety of wheeled vehicles” according to the scheme “Registration and accounting of in-vehicle emergency call devices in a vehicle.”

To connect vehicles to the EVAC system, automakers or official dealers provide the EVAC operator with information in the form of an Excel file indicating the vehicle VIN code and the ICCID code U(C)VEOS installed on the vehicle, as well as the make, model, color and year of manufacture of the vehicle.

Submit your registration details via the EVAC operator website.

After receiving the data, the EVAC Operator registers the vehicle and the device or emergency call system installed on it in the emergency call system database in accordance with the Registration Rules of the U(S)VEOS.

items[0].answer:
Technical Regulations of the Customs Union “On the Safety of Wheeled Vehicles” TR CU 018/2011, which came into force in the EAEU countries on January 1, 2017, obliges automakers to equip vehicles of categories M (used for transporting passengers) and N (used for transporting goods) with emergency terminals in case of emergency situations. 
Vehicles undergoing initial registration in the Republic of Kazakhstan, as well as vehicles transporting passengers, dangerous and large cargo, must be equipped with emergency call devices. 
Vehicles in operation in Kazakhstan may be equipped with emergency call devices on a voluntary basis.
items[0].question: Is equipping cars with emergency call devices mandatory for all car owners or only for cars sold in car dealerships?

Car owners can ask their questions regarding the operation of the EVAK system by writing to info@evak.online.
items[1].question: What kind of support does the system developer provide?

items[2].answer:
There is no need to re-equip vehicles with SIM cards belonging to other operators of emergency call systems of the Customs Union. 
To connect to the EVAC system and send calls for help in emergency situations, you must register the vehicle in the EVAC system database. 
Vehicle data for registration in the EVAC system is transmitted to the operator through auto manufacturers, vehicle importers or certified installation centers. 
The owner of the vehicle must request registration in the EVAC system from the organization from which the vehicle was purchased or in which the emergency call device was installed.
items[2].question: Is it necessary to re-equip a car equipped with an emergency call system with an ERA-GLONASS SIM card?

items[3].answer: There is no subscription fee to use the main function of the EVAC system.

items[4].answer:
System parameters must be checked once a year. 
You can check the parameters at certified installation centers. 
If additional functions are introduced and the car owner wants to connect to them, it is necessary to update the device software and enter into an agreement for the use of additional functions.
items[4].question: How often does the device require maintenance and software updates?

items[5].answer: The device for calling emergency services does not require additional settings if the car is used in another city in Kazakhstan.

The EVAC system SIM profile can be purchased from the GAIS EVAC operator from August 1, 2018. 
This SIM profile is designed in full compliance with ISO 7816 / ETSI TS 102.221 standards. 
To purchase a SIM profile, you must enter into a tripartite agreement.
items[0].question: Is there any official information that the EVAC SIM profile should be available from January 2019?

items[1].answer:
When going through the confirmation procedure, there is no link to the SIM profile of a specific national operator. 
Only the performance of the U(S)VEOS is assessed. 
According to GOST 34464-2015, the initial profile of the emergency call system operator is established in U(S)VEOS. 
The requirement for mandatory connection of vehicles to the EVAC system will apply to vehicles undergoing the initial registration procedure after January 1, 2019.
items[1].question: If so, does this only apply to vehicle types that have not previously undergone conformity assessment, or to all vehicles?

items[2].question: How are profiles transferred to the manufacturer?

items[3].answer:
To resolve issues of purchasing SIM profiles, as well as connecting U(S)VEOS to the EVAC system, a contact person has been identified: Marina Alkhazurova, tel. 
8(727) 221-77-95 ext. 
705.
items[3].question: Who will be the contact person when concluding direct contracts with manufacturers for the purchase of profiles?

items[4].answer:
To purchase a SIM profile, it is necessary to sign a tripartite agreement between the EVAC System Operator, the SIM card manufacturer and the car manufacturer (if it develops the U(S)VEOS itself, or directly with the U(S)VEOS manufacturer), which agrees on the terms of payment and delivery of SIM profiles. 
The EVAC system SIM profile can be purchased from the GAIS EVAC operator from August 1, 2018. 
This SIM profile is designed in full compliance with ISO 7816 / ETSI TS 102.221 standards. 
The use of OTA for distributing SIM profiles of the EVAC system will depend solely on the capabilities of the cellular equipment of national mobile operators of the Republic of Kazakhstan, as well as on the availability of all necessary agreements between the owner of the OTA platform and national mobile operators of the Republic of Kazakhstan.
items[4].question:

items[0].answer:
In Kazakhstan there are no special technical requirements for U(S)VEOS. 
Technical requirements for U(S)VEOS are uniform throughout the entire territory of the Customs Union. 
The main standard for U(C)VEOS is GOST 33464-2015 “Device/system for calling emergency operational services. 
General technical requirements".
items[0].question: Have technical requirements (methodological recommendations) been developed for devices/systems for calling emergency operational services that meet the requirements of the CU TR and Interstate Standards regarding the implementation of emergency calls on the territory of Kazakhstan using EVAC?

items[1].answer:
If U(S)VEOS fully complies with the requirements of TR CU 018/2011, no changes are required to use the EVAC SIM profile. 
The SIM chip on which the EVAC SIM profile is written must comply with the ETSI TS 102.671 standard.
items[1].question: Is the necessary information (technical specification/specification) available to begin the development and modification of the trailer hitch in relation to the EVAC profile?

items[2].answer:
S(V)EOS/U(V)EOS must comply with the standards GOST 33464-2015, GOST 33465-2015, GOST 33466-2015, GOST 33467-2015, GOST 33468-2015, GOST 33469-2015, GOST 33470-2015, GOST 
33471-2015, which define mandatory support for the GSM 900/1800 and UMTS 900/2000 standards.
items[2].question: Is it necessary to strictly comply with the radiotelephone requirements of the GSM 900 and GSM 1800, as well as UMTS 900 and UMTS 2000 standards?

items[6].answer: As a development of the system after 2019, this equipment and service can be connected.
items[6].question:
According to the latest data, HKTT reported that there are no plans to create a test service at the expense of the budget, and there are no plans to purchase equipment for sending SMS messages at the expense of the budget. 
Negotiations are currently underway with mobile operators about sending SMS through them. 
When is it planned to create a test service, as well as purchase equipment for sending SMS, which were not planned in the budget?

items[7].answer:
IKTT response: Using this number for the Test Service 79418100025 in Kazakhstan is impossible, since the ERA-GLONASS DEF code is 940, and in Kazakhstan the DEF code is 740. In this case, according to the manufacturers of terminals and SIM profiles, changes will be required to the terminal and SIM profile of the emergency call system. 
This will require additional testing.
items[7].question:
Changing the telephone number of the Test Service or SMS message delivery center should not lead to additional testing of the U(S)VEOS in case of compliance with the requirements of TR CU 018/2011. 
Since these numbers are included in the changeable parameters of U(S)VEOS in accordance with the interstate standard GOST 33464-2015 “Global navigation satellite system. 
EMERGENCY RESPONSE SYSTEM IN CASE OF ACCIDENTS. 
Device/system for calling emergency services in a car. 
General technical requirements". 
Changing these parameters should be possible remotely via SMS or by connecting a cable. 
In this regard, we ask you to allow for a transition period for EVAC SIM profiles.

items[8].answer:
Technical data is public information. 
According to the interstate standard GOST 33464-2015, the built-in SIM card must be made in the MFF2 form factor with support for GSM 900/GSM 1800/UMTS radiotelephone communications. 
The card must remain operational in an ambient temperature range from minus 40°C to plus 105°C. 
The total memory capacity on the SIM/eUICC card must be at least 64 KB. 
The card must be rated for DC voltage between 1.62 and 3.3 V. The system operator profile must be enabled on the SIM/eUICC. 
The card supports authentication algorithms (GSM-Milenage, Milenage, XOR, AES) and cryptography (CRC-32, DES, 3DES, MD5, SHA-1).

MNC – 09; 
MSIN – 740.

cards.text1: Technical and functional requirements for the device (system) for calling emergency services in accordance with TR CU 018/2011 and ST RK ISO 17575. Support for MSD, GSM/UMTS, GLONASS/GPS protocols, secure connection with the GAIS EVAC infrastructure.
cards.text2_1: To purchase identification cards, it is necessary to sign a tripartite Agreement between the Operator of the EVAC system (Institute of Space Technology and Technology), the Manufacturer of SIM cards and the Applicant, where the terms of payment and transfer are discussed.
cards.text2_2:
After concluding the Agreement, the Applicant sends the Operator a request for the required number of cards and makes payment at the rates approved by the Director of the Institute of Space Technology and Technology. 
The cost of the GAIS EVAC profile is 2 MCI 12% VAT.
cards.text2_3:
After payment, the Manufacturer produces and transfers to the Applicant the paid SIM cards, taking into account the ICCID ranges from the Operator. 
Production time is 1 month.
cards.text2_4:
The applicant installs the received card into the device (system) for calling in-vehicle emergency services and transfers the device to the vehicle manufacturer or installation centers. 
The operator registers cards in the emergency call system.
cards.text3:
The cost of the GAIS EVAC profile for the production of SIM cards is 5,864.42 tenge excluding VAT or 6,568.15 tenge including VAT. 
This tariff is valid throughout the Republic of Kazakhstan.
